name: Kraven

abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Endurance: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon üzerindeki yeni hasarsız debuff'ların süresini azaltır.
abilityDetails.Root: Köklenen şampiyonlar hareket edemez ama saldırabilir, bloklayabilir ve kaçabilir; özel saldırı Root'u kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Critical Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): E1'de köklenme uygular — E2'ye zorla. Köklenirsen özel saldırı kullanarak kurtul. Yetenek azaltıcı şampiyonlar da köklenmeyi önler.
signatureAbility:
Entrapment
While the Opponent is rooted Dash Attacks grant a Trample Passive, making the attack Unblockable except against Well-Timed Blocks
While the Opponent is rooted all Bleeds are Critical Bleeds, multiplying their Potency by [100 - 200]% of Kraven's Critical Damage.

abilitySections.title: Jungle Fighter
content: Heavy Attack: First hit inflicts a non-stacking Disorient Debuff, decreasing Block Proficiency and Defensive Ability Accuracy by 40% for 16 second(s).
Critical Hits: Inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [2,417.04] Direct over 8 second(s).

abilitySections.title: When Debuffed - Endurance Passive
content: Each time Kraven receives a non-damaging Debuff, reduce the duration of future non-damaging Debuffs by 10% for the rest of the fight. Max 8 stacks.

abilitySections.title: Trap
content: If the Opponent moves into a Trap, it springs and deals a Burst of [7,553.25] Direct Damage and Roots them for 5 second(s). Damage scales with Base Attack only. If the Opponent moves into the Trap during a special, the Trap is removed.
If the Opponent is pushed into the Trap by a Heavy or Special 2, Kraven has a 100% chance to place a new Trap when the Root expires.
Rooted Champions cannot move, but can still attack, block, and dodge. Activating a Special Attack removes Root and prevents it from applying.
While the Opponent is rooted, Kraven's Dash Attacks become Unstoppable, his damage over time Debuffs are paused and he gains [1,833.33] Critical Rating.
While the Opponent is rooted, their Combat Power Rate is reduced by 37.5%.

abilitySections.title: Suppression - Cross-Fight
content: Traps also inflict a Cross-Fight Suppression Passive on the Opponent, reducing Combat Power Rate by 6.25% for this and the next 5 fights. Max 2 stacks. Traps cannot suppress Opponents with Natural Class Advantage.
In the following fights Suppression Potency is increased by 100%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Root Debuff and Precision Buff are paused.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Kraven sets a Trap at the Opponent location, the Trap arms after 5 second(s) and lasts until triggered. New Traps replace existing ones. As a Defender Traps are placed at his location and arms immediately. Traps are not affected by Ability Accuracy reduction.
If the Opponent is already rooted by a Trap, Critical Damage Rating is increased by [239.13] for the duration of this Attack instead.
Bleed effects are paused.
Gain a non-stacking True Accuracy Buff for 20 second(s). Triggering a Trap refreshes this effect.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a Precision Buff, increasing Critical Rating by [1,416.67] for 20 second(s). Triggering a Trap refreshes this effect. Max 5 stacks.
The first hit is Unblockable and inflicts a Poison Debuff, reducing Health Recovery by 30% and Dealing [10,071] Direct Damage over 3 second(s).
If the Opponent is rooted, refresh all Bleed effects.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a Cruelty Buff, increasing Critical Damage Rating by [305.56] until Kraven is knocked down.
If the Opponent is rooted they gain no Power during the Special and the potency of the Cruelty Buff is increased by 100%.
If the Opponent is not rooted but a Trap is placed, even if not armed, the Trap springs regardless of the Opponent's position.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Entrapment
content: While the Opponent is rooted Dash Attacks grant a Trample Passive, making the attack Unblockable except against Well-Timed Blocks
While the Opponent is rooted all Bleeds are Critical Bleeds, multiplying their Potency by [100 - 200]% of Kraven's Critical Damage.
